question: In which of the following years was the first ever National Agriculture Policy announced?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **first National Agriculture Policy** of India was announced in the year **2000**.
 
• This policy was introduced to address the issues related to **growth, sustainability, and equity** in agriculture.
 
• The primary focus of the policy was to achieve a growth rate of **4% per annum** in agriculture and allied sectors.
